holy_shock_cost: Holy Shock top-rank mana cost (Classic rank 3; the client has rank 1 only)
lights_vigil_heal: Light's Vigil party heal at rank 3: the rank 1 tooltip (325-344) scaled by mana cost
lights_vigil_coef: Light's Vigil healing coefficient (Prayer of Healing's)
oath_of_light: Oath of Light bonus (tooltip), scaled down for lower ranks
healing_stream: Healing Stream Totem rank 5: healing per 2 s per party member (Classic)
mana_spring: Mana Spring Totem rank 4: mana per 2 s (Classic)
mana_tide: Mana Tide Totem: mana per use (rank 1 tooltip 88 x 4 ticks, scaled like Classic ranks)
water_shield_icd: Water Shield: one globe at most every 3.5 s, 2% of maximum mana each
innervate: Innervate: 20 s of 5x Spirit regeneration that continues while casting, 6 min cooldown (Classic)
blessing_of_wisdom: Blessing of Wisdom on the Paladin (client value)
spirit_regen: Spirit regeneration per class (Classic formulas), 5-second rule
prayer_of_mending_jumps: Prayer of Mending heals 6 times in a group (first target + 5 jumps), once on a lone tank
chain_heal_jumps: Chain Heal in a group: 3 targets at 100% / 50% / 25%
swiftmend: Swiftmend consumes the HoT (Classic); used on the last tick so no healing is lost
sub_level_20_penalty: Spells learned before level 20 lose 3.75% of their coefficient per level below 20 (Classic)
base_health: Level 60 base health per class (Classic, unchecked); health = base + 10 per Stamina
lay_on_hands: Lay on Hands heals for the Paladin's maximum health and drains all mana, so it is cast only when mana is ignored (max)
lightwell: Lightwell: all 5 charges are used; the rank 1 heal in the client is scaled by mana cost for rank 3; party only
desperate_prayer: Desperate Prayer heals only the Priest, so it counts in the party scenario only
armor_buff: Inspiration and Ancestral Healing: armor buff uptime on a tank = 1 - exp(-15 s x crit heals per second)
racial_cooldowns: Racial cooldowns are used on cooldown; Blood Fury and Eureka! are taken to affect healing

priest.note: Deep Holy: Spiritual Guidance, Spiritual Healing and Prayer of Mending.

talents.name: Spiritual Healing

This spell can only be placed on one target at a time per caster.

talents.name: Shadow Focus

talents.name: Blackout

talents.name: Improved Mind Blast

talents.name: Improved Shadow Word: Pain

talents.name: Shadow Reach

talents.name: Improved Psychic Scream

talents.name: Mind Flay
talents.text: 45 Mana · 20 yd range · Instant Assault the target's mind with Shadow energy, causing 63 Shadow damage over 3 sec and slowing their movement speed by 50%.

talents.name: Improved Mind Flay

talents.name: Dark Inspiration

talents.name: Vampiric Embrace

talents.name: Silence

talents.name: Devouring Contagion

talents.name: Early Demise
talents.text: Increases Shadow Word: Death's critical strike chance on targets at or below 20% health by 30%.

talents.name: Darkness
talents.text: Increases your Shadow damage done by 10%.

talents.name: Shadowform
talents.text: 40% of base mana · Instant · 1.5 sec cooldown Assume Shadowform, increasing your Shadow damage by 10%, reducing the Mana cost of all Shadow spells by 50%, increasing the critical strike damage bonus of your Shadow spells by 100%, and reducing Physical damage taken by you by 15%. However, you may not cast healing spells while in this form.

talents.text: 550 Mana · 40 yd range · 3 sec cast · 6 sec cooldown Heals the target and their party for 336 over 7 sec. Party members must be within 43.5 yards of target. The amount healed is applied quickly at first, and slows down as Wild Growth reaches its full duration.

talents.name: Convection

talents.name: Concussion

talents.name: Elemental Devastation

talents.name: Reverberation

talents.name: Elemental Warding
talents.text: Reduces damage taken from Fire, Frost, and Nature effects by 10%.

talents.name: Trial by Fire
talents.text: Increases the damage done by your Fire Nova spell by 20% and reduces its cooldown by 4 sec, and increases the duration of your Magma Totem by 20 sec.

talents.text: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Earthbound

talents.name: Elemental Reach
talents.text: Increases the range of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, and Fire Nova spells by 6 yards.

talents.name: Call of Thunder
talents.text: Increases the critical strike chance of your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells by 5%.

talents.name: Lightning Overload
talents.text: Gives your Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning spells a 30% chance to cast a second, similar spell on the same target at no additional cost that causes half damage and no threat.

talents.name: Elemental Fury
talents.text: Increases the critical strike damage bonus of your Searing and Magma Totems and your Fire, Frost, and Nature spells by 100%.

talents.name: Lightning Mastery
talents.text: Instant · 3 min cooldown Gain mastery over Lightning, reducing the cast time of your Lightning Bolt spell by 0.5 sec, and removing the cooldown from your Chain Lightning spell. Lasts 15 sec.

talents.name: Earth's Grasp
talents.text: Increases the health of your Stoneclaw Totem by 50% and the radius of your Earthbind Totem by 20%.

talents.name: Thundering Strikes
talents.text: Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 5%.

talents.name: Ancestral Knowledge

talents.name: Guardian Totems

talents.name: Mental Dexterity
talents.text: Increases your Attack Power by an amount equal to 150% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Improved Lightning Shield
talents.text: Increases the damage done by your Lightning Shield orbs by 15%.

talents.name: Elemental Weapons
talents.text: Increases the melee attack power bonus of your Rockbiter Weapon by 20%, your Windfury Weapon effect by 40% and increases the damage caused by your Flametongue Weapon and Frostbrand Weapon by 15%.

talents.name: Shamanistic Focus
talents.text: Reduces the mana cost of your Shock and Lightning Shield spells by 45%.

talents.name: Anticipation
talents.text: Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 6%.

talents.name: Toughness
talents.text: Increases your Stamina by 10%.

talents.name: Flurry
talents.text: Increases your attack speed by 30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a melee critical strike.

talents.name: Stormstrike
talents.text: 8% of base mana · Melee Range · Instant · 6 sec cooldown Instantly strike for 150% weapon damage and increase the damage you deal to the target with your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, or Earth Shock spell by 20% for 12 sec.

talents.name: Improved Ghost Wolf
talents.text: Reduces the cast time of your Ghost Wolf spell by 3 sec, and Ghost Wolf may be used indoors.

talents.name: Spirit Weapons
talents.text: Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks, reduces all threat generated by your attacks by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is not active, and increases all threat generated by 30% while Rockbiter Weapon is active.

talents.name: Mental Quickness
talents.text: Increases your spell damage and healing by up to 30% of your Intellect.

talents.name: Maelstrom Weapon
talents.text: When you deal damage with a melee attack, you have a chance to reduce the cast time and Mana cost of your next Lightning Bolt spell by 20%. Stacks up to 5 times. Lasts 30 sec.

talents.name: Rage of the Farseer
talents.text: Instant · 3 min cooldown Increases your attack speed by 30% for 25 sec.

talents.name: Improved Healing Wave

talents.name: Tidal Focus
talents.text: Reduces the Mana cost of your healing spells by 5% and improves your chance to hit by 5%.

talents.name: Mindfulness
talents.text: Allows 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting.

talents.name: Natural Grace
talents.text: Reduces the threat generated by your spells by 15%.

talents.name: Totemic Focus

talents.name: Ancestral Healing

talents.name: Healing Focus
talents.text: Gives your healing spells a 70% chance to not lose casting time when you take damage.

talents.name: Water Shield
talents.text: The caster is surrounded by 3 globes of water. When a spell, melee, or ranged attack hits the caster or when one of the caster's spells gets a critical result, 2% of maximum mana is restored to the caster, expending one water globe. Only one globe will activate every few seconds. Lasts 10 min. Only one Elemental Shield can be active on the Shaman at any one time.

talents.name: Tidal Mastery
talents.text: Increases the critical effect chance of your healing spells by 5%.

talents.name: Restorative Totems
talents.text: Increases the effect of your Mana Spring Totem by 25% and increases the effect of your Healing Stream Totem by 50%.

talents.name: Mana Tide Totem
talents.text: 10 Mana · Instant · 5 min cooldown Summons a Mana Tide Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster for 12 sec that restores 88 mana every 3 seconds to group members within 30 yards.

talents.name: Healing Way
talents.text: Increases the amount healed by your Healing Wave spell by 25%.

talents.name: Nature's Swiftness
talents.text: Instant · 3 min cooldown When activated, your next Nature spell with a casting time less than 10 sec. becomes an instant cast spell.

talents.name: Purification
talents.text: Increases the effectiveness of your healing spells by 10%.

talents.name: Riptide
talents.text: 150 Mana · 40 yd range · Instant · 12 sec cooldown Heals a friendly target for 445 over 15 sec, and increases the effectiveness of your Chain Heal casts directly on that target by 25%.
